findings_resolved.finding: Recovery-first admission rejected genuine secret_failure preparation retry before normal reserve could run
findings_resolved.resolution: Compensation candidates exclude authentic exact-old-lease preparation retry; normal reserve authenticates and atomically archives prior receipt before new live authorization

findings_resolved.finding: Successful recovery ownership could be dropped when unrelated subsequent forward reservation failed
findings_resolved.resolution: Return accepted recovery page directly; normal reserve runs only when recovery page is empty

findings_resolved.finding: Transaction-start expiry could already be stale after lock contention; final-page expiry guard was misplaced in empty-page branch
findings_resolved.resolution: Issue recovery expiry from clock_timestamp and validate all returned lease deadlines immediately before final return

findings_resolved.finding: Recovery response could exceed executor wire bound after ownership commit
findings_resolved.resolution: Check aggregate serialized response size before each ownership transition, with bounded page size

findings_resolved.finding: Original provider-call assertion observed an unrelated fixture dependency
findings_resolved.resolution: Install strict counted provider and workflow dependencies actually used by recovery worker

findings_resolved.finding: Recovery needed native forward and settlement purpose fences independent of application recovery flag
findings_resolved.resolution: Native source rejects pkce_recovery and native settlement admits only complete_pkce_cleanup for that kind
